open_evidence_requirements: Algorithmic novelty and a reliable learned-control advantage remain unestablished; this static check does not certify either.
No supplied real intersection footage/counts/timings establish camera accuracy, normalized-to-metric geometry or field timing calibration.
Interactive training remains v4/executed-action replay; audited research v5/proposed-action replay is a separate method, not automatic website migration.
Legacy live research has a separate gating FSM and lacks numerical parity with audited executed lamps; describe it as legacy visualization.
Authentication/authorization, concurrent-user state isolation, complete browser-storage lifecycle and deployment operations require a separate production acceptance exercise.
Controller/UQ/shield guarantees are limited to implemented simulated constraints and finite tests, not formal collision safety or real-world readiness.
Camera target FPS, pixel tracking gates, queue weights and signal timings are engineering assumptions without independent field calibration.
Historical research/calibration/profiles/calib_profile_v1.json is example data; its is_calibrated flag is not evidence of measured accuracy.
Source fixes require original source snapshots when replaying historical strict-hash studies. Old checkpoints, reports and archives are preserved.
This catalogue reviews named method-critical surfaces, not every numerical literal or every possible runtime environment override.

Reference roles distinguish implemented adaptations, conceptual foundations, software dependencies and related work. They do not certify global novelty, independent authorship or absence of plagiarism.

The service-ledger hybrid is a mechanics-verified research candidate. Its pressure-weighted allocation objective, traffic tradeoff, algorithmic novelty and learned-model connection remain unestablished; future evaluation needs a separate frozen matched-control study.
